agents.name: Med Lead
agents.capabilityNotes: BRIDGE (Douketis NEJM 2015): in AF on warfarin, no bridging was noninferior for ATE (0.4% vs 0.3%) with less major bleeding (1.3% vs 3.2%); not for mechanical valves or very high risk.

agents.name: Cardiology Lead
agents.capabilityNotes: REDUCE-AMI (Yndigegn NEJM 2024) + BBTC IPD (Kristensen NEJM 2026): post-MI with LVEF >=50% and no other indication, routine long-term beta-blocker did not cut death/MI/HF; not HFrEF or other indications.

agents.name: PCP Proctor
agents.capabilityNotes: ACCORD (Gerstein NEJM 2008): A1c target <6.0% in high-CV-risk T2D raised mortality (HR 1.22) without lowering the primary CV outcome; reject intensive target.

agents.name: OD Proctor
agents.capabilityNotes: Baltimore Eye Survey (Sommer 1991) + CNTGS 1998: IOP <21 mmHg does not rule out glaucoma; diagnose by optic nerve and field, and IOP lowering still slows NTG.

agents.name: Med Evidence
agents.capabilityNotes: ISIS-2 astrology subgroup + Sun BMJ 2010: a subgroup effect in a positive RCT is a hypothesis until it meets credibility criteria and replicates.

agents.name: Peptide Specialist
agents.capabilityNotes: GSH feedback on GCL is nonallosteric (glutamate-site + thiol-site binding), not allosteric (Richman & Meister, JBC 1975); durable suppression from exogenous GSH unproven.
